title: LCS BI Analyst
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

**LCS BI Analyst**
------------------

Noida/Pune - India

The BI Analyst will be responsible for end-to-end Power BI solution development, including data modelling, report design, performance optimization, and governance. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in ETL, Power BI, data analytics, and SQL based data sources, with the ability to translate business requirements into actionable insights and compelling data-driven stories.

This role requires a data-first mindset and strong analytical skills. Additionally, it demands hands-on experience in building scalable BI solutions, leveraging Power BI, Power Query, and enterprise data platforms (Azure SQL/SharePoint/Dataverse/Databricks). Knowledge of SAP and Salesforce.

This role will primarily focus on designing, developing, and supporting Power BI dashboards, data models, and reporting solutions to enable data-driven decision-making across global stakeholders.

  
  

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Gather and translate business requirements into scalable and impactful BI solutions.
* Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and semantic data models for enterprise use.
* Apply best practices in dimensional modeling (star schema) & semantic model design.
* Build & optimize data models using Power Query, DAX, and relational data principles.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and validation across all reports and datasets.
* Optimize dataset performance (model size, refresh efficiency, query performance).
* Align reporting outputs with standardized KPI definitions and business frameworks.
* Develop and maintain reusable datasets and governed data models.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues in collaboration with data owners.
  

  

**The Essentials - You will have:**

* Engineering graduate [B. Tech/BE - CS/IT/E&C]
* Experience in Power BI enterprise environments
* Deep expertise in PBI desktop, PBI Service, PBI Report Server and Power Query
* Advanced knowledge of DAX (write, tune and optimize) queries, calculated measures and tables.
* Strong experience building star and snowflake schema architectures, tabular models, and semantic data layers
* Advanced SQL querying, stored procedures, and performance optimization on relational databases (SQL Server, Azure SQL, Databricks)
* Experience connecting to diverse data sources, ETL and designing automated incremental data refreshes
* Row-Level Security (RLS) implementation, workspace management, app publishing, deployment pipelines & licensing structures.
  

  

**The Preferred – You might also have**

* 5+ Years of experience.

* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
* Experience supporting services, manufacturing, industrial automation, engineering, or technology organizations.
* Familiarity with ERP, CRM, service management, and financial systems.
* Experience with AI, advanced analytics, or automation platforms.
* Knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies and product-based delivery models.
  

  

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes …

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development...

and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

  

**#LI-Hybrid**

**#LI-SM1**

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Senior Research Analyst - Shareholder/Asset Recovery Research
description:
**About the Role**  
**The Wealth Finder** is looking for a **Senior Research Analyst** to strengthen its Research team, **which identifies and verifies shareholders to support the recovery of clients' lost shares and assets**. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can independently deliver high-accuracy research while also raising the bar for the analysts working alongside them. You will be expected to hit your own research and case targets and, in parallel, review and guide the work of junior analysts to keep data accuracy and turnaround consistent across the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct **detailed online research to identify and locate shareholders using criteria such as name, father's name, and address, working independently through your own case load.**
* Work with **online databases, public records, and other research tools to track down shareholder details and support the end-to-end share/asset recovery process**.
* Meet individual research output, accuracy, and turnaround targets as defined by Management
* Review the research findings, shareholder identification, and verification work completed by junior analysts before cases are closed or moved forward, checking for accuracy and completeness.
* Cross-check and verify shareholder details flagged by junior analysts, catching errors, mismatches, or gaps before they reach the client or the next stage of recovery.
* Provide structured feedback and on-the-job guidance to junior analysts to improve their research accuracy and speed over time.
* Collaborate with the wider team to ensure data accuracy and timely recovery of shares for clients across all active cases.
* Flag recurring errors, data-source issues, or inconsistencies in team output proactively to Management rather than after the fact.
* Contribute to improving internal research processes, verification checklists, and case-tracking practices used by the team.

**What We're Looking For**

* Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in **online research, data mining, public-records research, or similar investigative/verification work**.
* Proven **ability to independently identify, cross-check, and verify individuals' details (name, family details, address) with a high degree of accuracy**.
* Comfortable reviewing and correcting someone else's research work, with the judgment to catch genuine errors or gaps before a case moves forward.
* Strong command of search engines, public records, and other online resources used to locate and verify shareholder information.
* Clear, precise documentation habits — findings must be easy for the team and Management to verify and act on.
* Self-driven and comfortable being accountable for both your own case output and the quality of work around you.

title: Analyst - Data & Insights(CP)
description:

Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change\-makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.


In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services, and Shared Services.

  

  

**Who you will work with:**
